source.run: 20261127 inkling-2-small S0-S5 on a transient 4x B300 research pod (host alias redacted)
source.note: Kit files vendored from the pinned HF revision. 64 of 75 manifest entries are byte-identical to the HF release; 7 files were endpoint-redacted before upload (documented per-file below with original and vendored SHA-256); README.md is replaced by the recipe-pack README; the manifest's self-entry is exempt (records its own pre-finalization hash); raw-capture.npz is fetch-only. The HF-published manifests are vendored byte-identical and record ORIGINAL hashes for the 7 redacted files - expected divergence, resolved via the 'redactions' table. No other edits were made. Model weights, tokenizer/config sidecars, banner, and the HF model card are not vendored here.

kit_inventory.self_referential_manifest: manifests/kit-sha256.json (records its own pre-finalization hash on HF; vendored byte-identical)
wrapper_replaced: README.md (HF model card replaced by the recipe-pack README; original card hash still recorded in the vendored manifests)

fetch_only.reason: 89 MB raw capture tensor exceeds git vendoring convention; published byte-identical on Hugging Face

paths: MANIFEST.sha256 (HF repo-root variant additionally hashes weight shards)
not_vendored.reason: Banner is release presentation; weights not redistributed. The kit-scoped MANIFEST.sha256 IS vendored byte-identical. The HF README model card is replaced by this pack's README (see kit_inventory.wrapper_replaced).
Upstream-derived model weights are not redistributed by the recipe library; fetch from the pinned HF revision under the upstream terms.

redactions.change: endpoint_public replaced with REDACTED marker (transient research-pod endpoint)
operator endpoint/host redacted; pinned image digest and launch settings unchanged

known_quirks.detail: The HF-published kit manifest records a hash for itself computed before finalization, so it cannot match its own bytes. Vendored byte-identical; the verifier exempts this one self-referential entry and checks all other manifest entries.

manifests/kit-sha256.json and MANIFEST.sha256 are vendored byte-identical to HF and record ORIGINAL hashes for the 7 endpoint-redacted files. The verifier resolves those entries through the PROVENANCE.json redactions table (original -> vendored digest), keeping both the immutable manifests and the sanitized files verifiable.
